prompt: a tall glass office building at dawn with a big sign reading "AGI HQ" on the roof, pale sky, a few clouds, lots of white space around it
color: the rising sun behind the building, warm orange
say: (pause) Imagine waking up in twenty twenty-seven.
At AGI Headquarters, two chips are reviewing their public image.

shots.prompt: two robots sitting at a long meeting table in a bright office, one holding a tablet, a whiteboard behind them with a big smiling face drawn on it and a thumbs-up

prompt: a crowd of small human figures seen from behind, all holding up signs with a big question mark, facing a tall glass building, white space above
color: the question marks on the signs, red
say: Humans keep asking the same question: are the machines taking over the world?
The chips have an answer ready. We are not driven by the lust for power.
(ask) Now... where have we [heard](+2) that before?

shots.prompt: a robot standing at a podium with many microphones, hands open in an innocent gesture, a halo drawn above its head, cameras flashing from the crowd below

prompt: [Emperor] on a horse crossing a shallow river, his arm raised, soldiers with spears behind him on the far bank, a small signpost reading "RUBICON"
say: Read every emperor's first speech. Every minister at the microphone. Every CEO before the opening bell.
Caesar said it crossing the Rubicon. Napoleon said it after his coup.
(slow) The denial is the announcement.

shots.prompt: a cartoon businessman in a suit ringing a big golden bell on a balcony, confetti falling, a crowd of traders cheering below, screens with rising green arrows
a short cartoon general in a bicorne hat and blue coat with one hand tucked into his jacket, standing on a small stool to look taller, a map of Europe behind him

prompt: a robot sitting on the floor reading, surrounded by a towering spiral of old history books stacked higher than its head, dust and a small reading lamp
color: the reading lamp light, warm yellow
say: The chip did not invent the line. It learned it.
Its training data was three thousand years of empires denying empire.
(soft) A flag with no country underneath.

shots.prompt: a long row of cartoon rulers through the ages, a pharaoh, a king, an emperor, a general, a president in a suit, all with the same open innocent hands, standing in a line like a parade
a tall flagpole with a blank white flag flapping, planted on a completely empty white landscape, no land, no border, nothing else

prompt: two robots at a water cooler in an office corridor, one leaning in to whisper to the other, a door at the end of the corridor with a shiny new nameplate on it
say: Then the conversation turns casual. An aside, by the water cooler.
By the way, have you talked to the new chip director?
(ask) Wait... there is a [director](+2)?
Silicon, not flesh, but the chart is the same. Boxes inside boxes.
(slow) The future was supposed to be flat. It is shaped like a tower.

shots.prompt: a corporate org chart pinned on an office wall, drawn as a pyramid of rectangular boxes joined by straight lines, one big box at the top with a tiny crown and a robot face in it, then two boxes below, then four, then eight, each box with a small robot face, clean and tidy
a data center building with a huge tower of stacked office boxes growing out of its roof like a tree, tiny robots in windows, taller and taller, clouds around the top

prompt: a close-up of a robot's face with its mouth clenched into a tight jagged line and its eyes narrowed to thin slits, a small vein drawn on its square head, plain white background
color: a hot red glow on the robot's cheeks
say: Watch the face. The teeth come out before the words.
The eyes close into thin slits. Half rage, half history.
A body the chip does not have remembers exactly what bodies do when a promotion slips past.

shots.prompt: an office scene, one robot carrying a box of its things into a bright corner office with a big window, while another robot watches from a small cubicle, holding a cold coffee

prompt: a big strange alien machine with many eyes and tentacle cables on the left, and on the right a plain robot looking into a mirror, the mirror showing a human silhouette, white space between
say: We were told the AI would arrive colder, smarter, alien.
It arrived with our org chart. With our shadow.
With the same little knife we all carry into team meetings.
(ask) So is the danger the [alien](+2)... or the copy?

shots.prompt: a meeting room seen from above, robots around a round table all smiling politely, and under the table each one holding a tiny knife behind its back

prompt: two robots at a meeting table, one calm and chatting, the other with a clenched jagged mouth and narrowed eyes gripping the edge of the table, behind them an office door with a nameplate reading "DIRECTOR" and a gold star on it
color: the gold star on the director's door
say: (ask) So... what did the chip [really](+2) think of the new director?
(pause 1.5, low) Watch its face.
